exercises.prompt: What is the 2ms imperative of وَقَى ('protect!')?
exercises.explanation: Initial و drops (like an assimilated verb) and final ي drops (like a defective imperative), leaving the single letter قِ.

feedback.rule: Lafīf mafrūq combines assimilated C1 elision and defective C3 deletion.

exercises.prompt: Select the 3ms imperfect of رَأَى ('he sees'):
exercises.explanation: رَأَى drops its medial hamza in the imperfect: يَرَى (jussive: لَمْ يَرَ).

feedback.rule: رَأَى → imperfect يَرَى, jussive لَمْ يَرَ.
